infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Solace Life uses your microphone to record voice messages for your loved ones.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Solace Life uses your camera to record video messages for your loved ones.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Solace Life accesses your photo library so you can choose photos and videos to save as memories.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Solace Life saves received photo memories to your camera roll.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Solace Life uses speech recognition so you can speak your stories and memories instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Solace Life accesses your contacts so you can quickly add family members without typing.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Solace Life to access your microphone to record voice memos for your loved ones.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Solace Life to access your photos to create memory albums.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Solace Life to use your camera to record video messages.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Solace Life to save photo memories to your camera roll.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Solace Life to save photo memories to your camera roll.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Solace Life to access your contacts so you can quickly add family members without typing.
